method: Simulated (paper) trades only. Fill at reported ask; size 10 contracts; official taker fee; settlement at $1/$0 from official result; no settlement fee.

strategies.name: Follow big moves
strategies.description: After a move of at least $0.10, buy the side the price moved toward (YES after an up-move, NO after a down-move).

strategies.name: Fade big moves
strategies.description: After a move of at least $0.10, buy the opposite side (NO after an up-move, YES after a down-move).

strategies.name: High-ROI rule (heuristic)
strategies.description: Only for alerts flagged High-ROI by the rule in config/topics.json (entry <= $0.40, spread <= $0.05, 24h volume >= 100). Buys the side the move points to.
